page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8ia-2x.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual instance built on the KVM hypervisor. Hardware resources include 32 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at a base clock frequency of 3.4 GHz. System memory totals 256.0 GB, delivering 8.0 GB of memory per core. Compute acceleration is handled by two NVIDIA L20 GPUs based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, providing 96 GB of aggregate VRAM across both accelerators.

Networking performance is defined by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps. The instance contains no bundled local storage, meaning operating system disks and persistent file data must rely on external network-attached cloud storage. In addition, zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

The combination of dual enterprise GPUs and an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio supports resource-intensive computing without the overhead of higher vCPU tiers. Primary workloads suited for this configuration include artificial intelligence inference, intermediate model fine-tuning, scientific simulation, video transcode pipelines, and GPU-driven analytical workloads.

The instance is configured with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU, and dual NVIDIA L20 GPUs from the Ada Lovelace architecture with 96 GB of aggregate VRAM. Baseline networking provides 20 Gbps throughput. The configuration provides no local disk storage, requiring external network-attached block volumes for system execution and data storage, and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. With high GPU memory density and an 8:1 memory-to-core allocation, ecs.gn8ia-2x.8xlarge is designed for distributed deep learning inference, neural network fine-tuning, video processing, and data transformation tasks.
